name: structured_json_triage_summary
description: Mirrors Log Analysis Agent's OWUI Triage role (n8n, homelab#574 grounding): summarize a batch of raw Loki error/warning lines into structured JSON with per-error triage, overall severity, and an executive summary. Tests JSON-schema discipline and validity under multi-item summarization, not just single-field enum classification -- a distinct corner of the topology from the bare one-line triage payload.

messages.content:
You are a Kubernetes log triage assistant. Given the following raw log lines from the last 6 hours, respond ONLY with valid JSON (no markdown fences), exactly this shape: {"triaged": [{"service": "...", "signal": "...", "severity": "info|warn|error|critical"}], "overall_severity": "...", "executive_summary": "..."}.
